name: Standard
overview: The Bible presents the standard as a significant emblem used by the tribes of Israel to organize their camps and marches, symbolizing identity and order, as seen in Numbers 1:52 and 2:2. Beyond its practical military function, the standard also serves a figurative role, representing God's salvation and presence, as believers set up banners in His name (Psalms 20:5) and as a symbol of divine protection and beauty (Song of Solomon 6:4, 6:10). Isaiah 49:22 further reveals the standard as a sign of God's promise to gather and uplift His people, extending His reach to the nations.
